outsideScope: {name} is outside {scope}. Open it from its own desktop shortcut.
reloaded: {name} reloaded. The listing is unchanged on a read-only volume.
filedReadOnly: {name} is filed read-only. Opening it in the archive reader is not connected yet.
expungedHint: Expunged records are removed from discoverability. There is no listing to open.
emptyNote: This folder contains no files or subfolders.
noticeCreateHeading: The archive volume is read only
noticeCreateBody: Folders are created by the filing service when a case is opened, never from a workstation. This terminal holds a read-only mount of the archive, so nothing new can be written here.
noticeClipboardHeading: Cut, copy, and paste are disabled
noticeClipboardBody: Filed records are referenced by their case, not copied between folders. Moving one would leave the incident file without the record it cites, so the filing service refuses both directions on this volume.
noticeDeleteHeading: Nothing can be deleted from here
noticeDeleteBody: Disposal is a scheduled act with a named officer attached to it. The retention schedule has no disposal line for this volume, so deletion is refused at the filesystem.
noticeRenameBody: A record's name carries its case code, and the index is keyed on that name. Renaming is refused so a filed record cannot be separated from the code that finds it.
noticeAboutBody: Workstation file browser for CIRCA/OS. This build lists the local volume and the archive mount it exposes: My Documents, Archive, Organizations, System, the Recycle Bin, and _EXPUNGED. The archive mount is read only.
noticePolicyBody: The local volume holds drafts and exports. The archive mount holds filed records and cases. Recycle Bin items are recoverable for thirty days, after which the retention schedule decides. _EXPUNGED holds nothing and reports a count instead: expunged records are removed from discoverability entirely, so there is no listing to open.
noticeEmptyBody: Emptying would dispose of recoverable records ahead of the retention schedule, which has no disposal line for this volume. The bin is emptied by that schedule when the thirty days elapse.
